info.name: OnlineStoreSystem - ecommerce integration
info.description:
File: postman/ecommerce_integration.json

End-to-end tests for the four OnlineStoreSystem services and the orchestrated checkout saga.
Run everything with the Collection Runner or newman:

    npx newman run postman/ecommerce_integration.json --folder "00 Health" ...
    npx newman run postman/ecommerce_integration.json

Every request gets a generated X-Correlation-Id (collection pre-request script) unless it pins one, and every error response is asserted to be RFC 7807 application/problem+json carrying that correlation id.
Folder 07 contains manual resilience experiments and is skipped automatically by newman when the services are healthy (it accepts 202 or 503).

exec: // Correlation id at the edge: generate one per request unless the request already sets it.

07 Resilience & tracing (manual)
item.description:
Manual experiments - not part of the automated run (use the folder runner on its own):
1. Stop CatalogService and send 'Checkout during Catalog outage': OrderService retries with exponential backoff + jitter, then answers 503 RFC 7807.
2. Restart CatalogService with `--FaultInjection:Enabled=true` and send it again: two 503s are retried and the checkout succeeds (202).
3. grep the fixed correlation id `postman-trace-demo` in logs/*.log to see the request in every service.
